Prepare cells from your tissue of interest without lysing erythrocytes

Filter the cells with a 70 m cell strainer, centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes, and resuspend in anappropriate volume of MojoSortTM Buffer. Count and adjust the cell concentration to 1 x 108 cells/mL.

Aliquot 100 L of cell suspension (107 cells) into a new tube. Add 10 L of the Biotin-Antibody Cocktail, mix well and incubate on ice for 15 minutes. Optional: Keep unused cells, or take an aliquot before adding the cocktail to monitor purity and yield.

Resuspend the beads by vortexing, maximum speed, 5 touches. Add 10 L of Streptavidin Nanobeads. Mix well and incubate on ice for 15 minutes. Scale up the volume accordingly if separating more cells. For example, add 100 L for 1 x 108 cells. When working with less than 107 cells, use indicated volumesfor 107 cells.
Wash the cells by adding 3 mL of MojoSortTM Buffer; centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes, discard supernatant. Resuspend the cells in 3 mL of MojoSortTM Buffer.

Place the tube in the magnet for 5 minutes. Pour out and collect the liquid. These are your cells of interest; DO NOT DISCARD. If needed, add 3 mL of MojoSortTM Buffer and repeat steps 8 and 9 with the magnetically labeled fraction up to two times, and then pool the unlabeled fractions.
